description: This file contains functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades for a platform, including partition verification, image copying, and device writing routines.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout of the provided image matches the existing device; compares partition tables and warns if changes are detected.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration data to the appropriate partition mounted at /mnt.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process: verifies device, optionally saves partitions, copies images, updates U-Boot, and writes partition images and UUID.
